stories.title: Generate Interactive Competency Badge Pathway Visualizer with D3.js
stories.description: Create D3.js visualization showing L3→L4→L5 skill progression chains with prerequisite dependencies. Each competency displays as a badge node with link arrows indicating progression paths. Clicking a badge reveals associated CoCu units, learning outcomes, and assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Output: scripts/generate_badge_pathway.py → output/badge_pathway_visualization.html with embedded D3.js and CSS, no external dependencies
Function signature: generate_badge_pathways(cocudir) returns HTML string with clickable nodes; each node links to CoCu file path and line number in markdown
Validation: Ensure all L3 competencies have L4 predecessors; L4→L5 progression unbroken; export badge_map.json with node/edge definitions

stories.title: Extract and Build Searchable Bilingual Glossary Database from All CoCu Files
stories.description: Parse all 20 CoCu markdown files to extract key terms from tables, create SQLite glossary database with English/Bahasa Malaysia definitions, phonetic guides, and context citations. Output searchable HTML reference guide with copy-to-clipboard and PDF export.
acceptanceCriteria: Script: scripts/extract_glossary.py reads content/IT-020-*/*.md, builds output/glossary_database.db with schema: term(id, en_term, ms_term, en_def, ms_def, ipa_phonetic, cocu_file, line_num)
HTML output: output/glossary_reference.html with full-text search, bilingual filtering, print-to-PDF; minimum 150 terms extracted
Function: build_glossary(cocudir, outputdir) returns count of terms extracted; validate no duplicate entries across levels

stories.title: Generate Equipment Specification Sheets with EOL Tracking and Procurement Metadata
stories.description: For each equipment mentioned in any CoCu table, extract specifications (type, model, OS support, processor gen) and generate detailed spec sheets. Link to vendor EOL dates, supported software versions, and estimated replacement cycles per NOSS currency standards.
acceptanceCriteria: Output: output/equipment_catalog.xlsx with tabs: Equipment Summary, Vendor EOL Dates, OS Compatibility Matrix, Procurement Guide; scripts/generate_equipment_specs.py extracts equipment from all CoCu files
Function: extract_equipment(cocudir) → CSV with columns: equipment_name, model, vendor, eol_date, support_end_year, curriculum_impact (which CoCu units depend on it)
Validation: Cross-check all 20 CoCu files for equipment mentions; flag equipment with EOL < 2027; generate procurement recommendations JSON

stories.title: Create Student Learning Portfolio SPA Template with Evidence Upload and Competency Mapping
stories.description: Generate standalone HTML5 Single Page App template for students to upload evidence (screenshots, documents, certificates) mapped to course competencies. Uses localStorage for offline persistence, automatic tagging, and competency progress tracking with visual progress bars.
acceptanceCriteria: Output: output/student_portfolio_template.html with embedded CSS/JS (no external dependencies); includes competency checklist auto-populated from learning_outcome_matrices.json
Features: File upload with drag-drop, evidence categorization (Assessment/Certificate/Project/Reflection), date tracking, competency linking, progress visualization with Plotly.js
Validation: Ensure portfolio JSON schema exports compatible with MySPIKE submission; test on offline mode (localStorage); minimum 200 lines of HTML+JS

stories.title: Build Instructor Misconception Toolkit with Facilitation Strategies per Work Activity
stories.description: For each work activity in every CoCu, analyze learning outcomes and identify 3-5 common student misconceptions based on Bloom's taxonomy levels. Generate facilitation guide with teaching strategies, formative questions to diagnose misconceptions, and correction techniques.
acceptanceCriteria: Script: scripts/generate_misconception_guide.py reads all CoCu files, outputs output/instructor_misconceptions_guide.docx with format: [Work Activity] → Misconception List → Diagnostic Questions → Correction Strategies
Each misconception entry includes: incorrect student belief, correct concept, Bloom's level (1-6), formative question example, teaching technique recommendation
Function: extract_misconceptions(cocudir) → JSON with structure: level, cocu_unit, work_activity, misconceptions(belief, correction, level, diagnostic_q, strategy)

stories.title: Generate MySPIKE Submission Manifest with Full Compliance Metadata Aggregation
stories.description: Create master manifest JSON file listing all 20 CoCu files with complete metadata: contact hours (total/Knowledge%/Performance%), assessment coverage (rubric count, question bank size), bilingual status (English/Bahasa Malaysia word counts), equipment list, compliance checklist items, and submission readiness status.
acceptanceCriteria: Output: output/myspi ke_submission_manifest.json with schema: level, cocu_list(id, title, contact_hrs, knowledge_pct, performance_pct, languages, assessment_items, equipment_count, compliance_checks_passed)

Validation: Cross-check all 20 CoCu files exist; verify 30/70 split per unit; validate bilingual content present; confirm all mandatory sections present; generate JSON schema for submission validation
Function: generate_submission_manifest(cocudir, outputdir) → manifest dict; run before JPK submission to identify blocking compliance issues

stories.title: Build Curriculum Review Audit Trail with Git History and Approval Checkpoints
stories.description: Generate HTML audit report tracking all CoCu file modifications via git history, showing who changed what, when, and compliance validation status at each checkpoint. Link commits to specific sections changed (header, assessment, learning outcomes) for compliance traceability.
acceptanceCriteria: Script: scripts/generate_audit_trail.py parses git log for all content/IT-020-*/*.md files, generates output/curriculum_audit_trail.html with timeline view showing commits, diffs, and compliance status
Report format: [Date] [Author] [Commit] [Files Changed] [Compliance Checks] [Status: Pass/Warning/Fail] with expandable diff view
Function: build_audit_trail(cocudir, gitdir, outputdir) → HTML with git commit hashes linked; JSON export of audit events for analytics

stories.title: Analyze Skill Gaps Between Course Learning Outcomes and Real Job Postings
stories.description: Compare all course learning outcomes against ISCO-08 job classification codes and sample job postings from LinkedIn/JobStreet. Identify skills taught vs. skills demanded by employers, flag gaps, and recommend curriculum refinements to improve job-market alignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Script: scripts/analyze_skill_gaps.py reads learning_outcome_matrices.json, queries ISCO-08 database (included), outputs output/skill_gap_analysis.json with gaps: skill_name, taught_level, job_demand_level, cocuunits_covering_it, gap_severity (low/medium/high)
Report: skill_gap_analysis.html with visualization showing taught vs. demanded skills per job role; recommendations prioritized by employer demand frequency
Validation: Cross-reference at least 5 job roles per level (L3/L4/L5); ensure all ISCO codes valid; generate feedback loop for curriculum owner to prioritize gap closures

stories.title: Create Learner Grade Distribution and Item Analysis Tool for Assessment Refinement
stories.description: Build Excel template + Python analysis script for instructors to collect assessment scores and perform item analysis (difficulty index, discrimination index, key distractor frequency). Provides statistical recommendations for revising weak assessment items and balancing assessment difficulty.
acceptanceCriteria: Template: output/assessment_item_analysis_template.xlsx with sheets: Raw Scores, Item Analysis, Difficulty Distribution, Discrimination Report; scripts/analyze_assessment_items.py analyzes responses

Output: output/assessment_analysis_report.xlsx with calculations: difficulty_index (p-value), discrimination_index (rpbis), frequency of each response option, and recommendation flags (difficult/discriminating/flawed)
Function: analyze_items(scoresfile) → recommendations dict; validation: require minimum 30 responses per item for statistical validity

stories.title: Generate Contact Hour Micro-Learning Units with 15-Minute Lesson Plans and Time Budgets
stories.description: Decompose each CoCu into 15-minute learning chunks with specific learning objectives, micro-assessments, time budgets, and resource links. Output micro-unit schedules in JSON format compatible with Learning Management Systems and video subtitle tracks (SRT format).
acceptanceCriteria: Script: scripts/generate_micro_units.py parses CoCu markdown, breaks work activities into 15-min units, outputs output/micro_learning_units.json with structure: level, cocu_id, unit_sequence, objective, duration_mins, micro_assessment_q, resources, difficulty_level
Each micro-unit maps to: specific learning outcome code, Bloom's level, knowledge/performance split, resource recommendations (equipment/software/documents)
Validation: Sum of micro-unit durations = total CoCu contact hours; generate SRT subtitles (output/micro_unit_subtitles_l{3,4,5}.srt) for video timestamping
